metadata.name: mybarpool
metadata.description: MyBarPool: NFL boxes on Solana. The on-chain program.

instructions.name: buy
docs: PROGRAM §4.3 `buy`: buy `count` boxes at the pool's price; positions are assigned by
§6.1 from the SlotHashes sysvar. The 25th box locks the pool. Signer and payer: the
buyer. Gating by `access_type`: a `Link` pool needs the optional `gate_key` account
present and signing; an `Allowlist` pool needs `allowlist_proof`, the §6.4 Merkle proof
for the buyer (at most 32 entries); a `Public` pool ignores both. Emits `BoxesBought`
and, on lock, `PoolLocked`.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: The buyer; pays `count × price` and the transaction fee.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; read for `paused` and the limits.

accounts.name: game
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord`, the pool's game (`has_one`); read for status and kickoff.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields.

accounts.name: vault
docs: PROGRAM §3.4 vault at `["vault", pool]` with the stored bump; `pool.vault` is the
only address `buy` accepts for it. SOL: system-owned, lamports only. SPL: a token account
owned by the pool PDA, which `transfer_checked` into it verifies.

accounts.name: counter
docs: PROGRAM §3.5 the creator's counter for this game; decremented when this buy locks.

accounts.name: wallet_override
docs: The creator's `WalletOverride` slot at `["override", pool.creator]` (seeds
constraint); read only when initialised and only when the buyer is the creator.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The pool's mint (`address = pool.mint`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: buyer_token_account
docs: The buyer's token account for the mint; SPL pools only.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The pool's token program (checked against `pool.token_program`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: slot_hashes
docs: The SlotHashes sysvar by address; PROGRAM §6.1's `slothash` comes from it and
never from instruction data.

accounts.name: gate_key
docs: PROGRAM §4.3: on a `Link` pool this must be present, equal to `pool.gate_key` and
signing (`GateKeyNotSigner` for all three); ignored on `Public` and `Allowlist` pools.
Typed `UncheckedAccount` rather than `Signer` so an absent or non-signing key is §8's
6017 and not Anchor's own error.

instructions.name: cancel_pool
docs: PROGRAM §4.6 `cancel_pool`: the admin cancels a pool that has paid nobody; it becomes
`Returned` with `cancelled_by_admin` set, and `return_boxes` pays the owners.

accounts.name: admin
docs: `config.admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; `has_one = admin`.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields; `Open`, `Locked` or `Drawn` with
fees untaken.

accounts.name: counter
docs: PROGRAM §3.5 the creator's counter for this game; required and decremented exactly when
the pool is `Open`, never read otherwise.

instructions.name: close_counter
docs: PROGRAM §3.5 `close_counter`: close a `CreatorCounter` whose `open_count` is zero, rent to
`config.fee_wallet`. Permissionless.

accounts.name: counter
docs: PROGRAM §3.5 `CreatorCounter`, re-derived from its own fields; closed to `fee_wallet`.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; names the rent destination.

accounts.name: fee_wallet
docs: `config.fee_wallet` by `has_one`; a destination only, never `SystemAccount`
(PROGRAM §10: a wallet whose owner may change must still be payable).

instructions.name: close_pool
docs: PROGRAM §4.5 `close_pool`: close a terminal pool with no open sponsorship, sweeping the
vault's remaining balance and both accounts' rent to `fee_wallet` (the creator when
abandoned). Permissionless. Emits `PoolClosed`.
`arbitrary_cpi_call` is allowed here for the same reason as on the handler (see
`instructions/close_pool.rs`): the lint attaches its report to the function it started from,
and this entry point reaches the vault's outbound CPIs through the handler.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the rent of the destination's associated token account when it is missing
and the vault holds tokens. Signs nothing else.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; read for `fee_wallet`.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields; closed by the handler to the
destination (`pool.close(...)`, since the destination depends on `abandoned`).

accounts.name: vault
docs: PROGRAM §3.4 vault; SOL: its whole balance moves out and the runtime reaps it; SPL: the
token balance is swept, then the account is closed with the pool PDA as authority.

accounts.name: fee_wallet
docs: The platform's destination (PROGRAM §3.1); always passed so the account list is static.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The creator; the destination when the pool was abandoned (ARCHITECTURE › Pool creation).

accounts.name: mint
docs: The pool's mint (`address = pool.mint`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: destination_token_account
docs: The destination's associated token account; SPL pools only; created idempotently only
when the vault holds tokens to sweep.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The pool's token program (checked against `pool.token_program`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: The associated-token program, a fixed address; SPL pools only.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: For the SOL sweep out of the vault and any ATA rent.

instructions.name: close_sponsorship
docs: PROGRAM §4.6 `close_sponsorship`: on a `Settled` or `Split` pool, close a spent
sponsorship's account to its wallet.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields; `Settled` or `Split`.

accounts.name: sponsorship
docs: PROGRAM §3.7 `Sponsorship` for this pool and `sponsor`; closed to `sponsor`.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: The sponsor's wallet; receives the account's rent.

instructions.name: close_wallet_override
docs: PROGRAM §4.1 `close_wallet_override`: close it, rent to admin. Signer: admin.
Emits `OverrideClosed`.

accounts.name: admin
docs: `config.admin`; receives the rent.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`.

accounts.name: wallet_override
docs: PROGRAM §3.6 `WalletOverride` for `wallet`; closed, rent to admin.

instructions.name: create_game
docs: PROGRAM §4.2 `create_game`: create the `GameRecord` for `key` at `scheduled_kickoff`
(must be in the future; §2 key rules, preseason only with `preseason_enabled`).
Signer and payer: the keeper. Emits `GameCreated`.

accounts.name: score_authority
docs: The keeper, `config.score_authority`; pays the record's rent.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; read for `score_authority` and `preseason_enabled`.

accounts.name: game
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord` at the six seeds; one per (key, scheduled kickoff).

instructions.name: create_pool
docs: PROGRAM §4.3 `create_pool`: create a `Pool`, its vault and (when absent) the creator's
counter; fix the §5.1 fee amounts; optionally buy the creator's first boxes. Signer and
payer: the creator. Emits `PoolCreated`, then `BoxesBought` and `PoolLocked` as earned.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The creator; pays the rent of the pool, the vault and (first time) the counter, plus any
initial boxes.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; read for `paused`, the token rule, the fee bps and limits.

accounts.name: game
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord`, re-derived from its own fields (the Step 3 discipline).

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool` at `["pool", game, creator, nonce]`; must not exist yet.

accounts.name: vault
docs: PDA of the pool at `["vault", pool]` (seeds constraint); funded (SOL) or
initialised as a token account (SPL) by this handler, nothing else.

accounts.name: counter
docs: PROGRAM §3.5 `CreatorCounter` at `["counter", creator, game]`; created when absent.

accounts.name: wallet_override
docs: The creator's `WalletOverride` slot at `["override", creator]` (seeds
constraint); read only when initialised.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The rule's mint; SPL pools only (checked against `rule.mint`).

accounts.name: creator_token_account
docs: The creator's token account for the mint; SPL pools with `initial_boxes > 0` only.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The rule's token program; SPL pools only (checked against `rule.token_program`).

accounts.name: slot_hashes
docs: The SlotHashes sysvar by address; read only when `initial_boxes > 0`.

instructions.name: draw
docs: PROGRAM §4.4 `draw`: on a sampled, revealed `Var` that still carries the verified hash
(and not the fallback), recompute the value and derive both axes (§6.2). Signer: the
keeper. Emits `DigitsDrawn`.

accounts.name: score_authority
docs: The keeper, `config.score_authority`.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields.

accounts.name: var
docs: The recorded `Var`, sampled through this program and revealed by its provider.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: PROGRAM §4.1 `initialize`: create `PlatformConfig`. Signer: the program's upgrade
authority, which becomes `admin`. Emits `ConfigUpdated`.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The program's upgrade authority; pays for the config and becomes `admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`, created here. One per deployment.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's `ProgramData`; its upgrade authority must be the signer.

accounts.name: mint_1
docs: Mint for token index 1 (SKR), when its rule names one.

accounts.name: mint_2
docs: Mint for token index 2 (ORE), when its rule names one.

instructions.name: mark_game
docs: PROGRAM §4.2 `mark_game`: mark a `Scheduled` record `Postponed` or `Cancelled` (only
before any post) or `Suspended` (any time before `Final`). Irreversible. Signer: the
admin. Emits `GameMarked`.

accounts.name: admin
docs: `config.admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`.

accounts.name: game
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord`, re-derived from its own key and scheduled kickoff.

instructions.name: post_scores
docs: PROGRAM §4.2 `post_scores`: post the cumulative score at the end of `quarter` (1–4, in
order, at least 15 minutes after kickoff or the previous post, never decreasing;
`is_final` on the fourth only). The fourth post sets `Final`. Signer: the keeper. Emits
`ScoresPosted`.

accounts.name: score_authority
docs: The keeper, `config.score_authority`.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`.

accounts.name: game
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord`, re-derived from its own key and scheduled kickoff.

instructions.name: reclaim
docs: PROGRAM §4.6 `reclaim`: thirty days after the scheduled kickoff, a box owner takes back
their unreturned boxes (price while fees are untaken, split share once they are); an
unresolved pool becomes `abandoned`.

accounts.name: box_owner
docs: A box owner of the pool; pays the rent of their own associated token account when this
call creates it.

accounts.name: game
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord`, the pool's game (`has_one`); read for the scheduled kickoff.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields; anything but `Settled`.

accounts.name: vault
docs: PROGRAM §3.4 vault; the reclaim comes out of it.

accounts.name: counter
docs: PROGRAM §3.5 the creator's counter for this game; required and decremented exactly when
the pool is still `Open`, never read otherwise.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The pool's mint (`address = pool.mint`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: box_owner_token_account
docs: pools only.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The pool's token program (checked against `pool.token_program`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: The associated-token program, a fixed address; SPL pools only.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: For the SOL transfer out of the vault and any ATA rent.

instructions.name: reclaim_sponsorship
docs: PROGRAM §4.6 `reclaim_sponsorship`: thirty days after the scheduled kickoff, a sponsor
of a pool with its fees untaken takes their sponsorship back and closes its account.
`arbitrary_cpi_call` is allowed here for the same reason as on the handler (see
`instructions/reclaim_sponsorship.rs`): the lint attaches its report to the function it started from,
and this entry point reaches the vault's outbound CPIs through the handler.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: The sponsor, the wallet of the `Sponsorship` (its seed); receives the sponsorship and
the rent, and pays the rent of their own associated token account when this call
creates it.

accounts.name: game
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord`, the pool's game (`has_one`); read for the scheduled kickoff.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields; fees untaken.

accounts.name: vault
docs: PROGRAM §3.4 vault; the sponsorship comes out of it.

accounts.name: sponsorship
docs: PROGRAM §3.7 `Sponsorship` for this pool and the signer; closed to `sponsor` on
success.

accounts.name: counter
docs: PROGRAM §3.5 the creator's counter for this game; required and decremented exactly when
the pool is still `Open`, never read otherwise.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The pool's mint (`address = pool.mint`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: sponsor_token_account
docs: pools only.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The pool's token program (checked against `pool.token_program`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: The associated-token program, a fixed address; SPL pools only.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: For the SOL transfer out of the vault and any ATA rent.

instructions.name: replace_var
docs: PROGRAM §4.4 `replace_var`: bind a fresh `Var` in place of one whose window was missed;
at most twice, never on a pool with a verified sample. Signer: the admin. Emits
`VarReplaced`.

accounts.name: admin
docs: `config.admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; read for `entropy_provider`.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields.

accounts.name: new_var
docs: The fresh `Var` bound in place of `pool.var`.

instructions.name: return_boxes
docs: PROGRAM §4.6 `return_boxes`: on a pool that is unfilled at kickoff, on a game marked
postponed, cancelled or suspended before any payout, or on a pool the admin cancelled,
move the pool to `Returned` and pay the owners in the remaining accounts the purchase
price of their unreturned boxes.

docs: The keeper, `config.score_authority`; pays the rent of any associated token account
this call creates.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; `has_one = score_authority`.

accounts.name: game
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord`, the pool's game (`has_one`); read for its status and the
recorded kickoff.

docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields.

accounts.name: vault
docs: PROGRAM §3.4 vault; every return comes out of it.

docs: PROGRAM §3.5 the creator's counter for this game; required and decremented exactly on
the call that takes the pool out of `Open`, never read otherwise.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The pool's mint (`address = pool.mint`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: token_program

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: The associated-token program, a fixed address; SPL pools only.

instructions.name: return_sponsorship
docs: PROGRAM §4.6 `return_sponsorship`: on a `Returned` pool with its fees untaken, return
one sponsorship in full to the recorded wallet and close its account.
`arbitrary_cpi_call` is allowed here for the same reason as on the handler (see
`instructions/return_sponsorship.rs`): the lint attaches its report to the function it started from,
and this entry point reaches the vault's outbound CPIs through the handler.

accounts.name: score_authority
docs: The keeper, `config.score_authority`; pays the rent of the sponsor's associated token
account when this call creates it.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; `has_one = score_authority`.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields; must be `Returned` with fees
untaken.

accounts.name: vault
docs: PROGRAM §3.4 vault; the sponsorship comes out of it.

accounts.name: sponsorship
docs: PROGRAM §3.7 `Sponsorship` for this pool and `sponsor`; closed to `sponsor` on success.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: The sponsor's wallet; receives the sponsorship (SOL) and the account's rent.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The pool's mint (`address = pool.mint`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: sponsor_token_account
docs: SPL pools only.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The pool's token program (checked against `pool.token_program`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: The associated-token program, a fixed address; SPL pools only.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: For the SOL transfer out of the vault and any ATA rent.

instructions.name: rotate_gate_key
docs: PROGRAM §4.3 `rotate_gate_key`: set a `Link` pool's gate key. Signer: the creator.
Emits `GateKeyRotated`.

accounts.name: creator
docs: `pool.creator`.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields; `has_one = creator`.

instructions.name: sample_var
docs: PROGRAM §4.4 `sample_var`: at or after the `Var`'s `end_at`, CPI Entropy `Sample` if
unsampled, then prove against SlotHashes that the hash it carries is the real hash of
`end_at`, and record slot and hash on the pool. Signer: anyone. Emits `VarSampled`.

accounts.name: sampler
docs: Any wallet; the CPI's signer and nothing else.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields.

accounts.name: var
docs: handler. Writable because Entropy's `Sample` writes `slot_hash`.

accounts.name: slot_hashes
docs: handler's own `hash_for_slot`.

accounts.name: entropy_program
docs: CPI target is this constant, never a caller-supplied key.

instructions.name: set_var
docs: PROGRAM §4.4 `set_var`: bind a fresh, committed, unsampled Entropy `Var` from the
configured provider to a `Locked` pool. Signer: the keeper. Emits `VarSet`.

accounts.name: score_authority
docs: The keeper, `config.score_authority`.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; read for `entropy_provider`.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields.

accounts.name: var
docs: `Var::try_from_account` in the handler. Not an Anchor account (steel layout).

instructions.name: set_wallet_override
docs: PROGRAM §4.1 `set_wallet_override`: create or update a `WalletOverride`. Signer: admin.
Emits `OverrideSet`.

accounts.name: admin
docs: `config.admin`; pays the rent on create.

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`.

accounts.name: wallet_override
docs: PROGRAM §3.6 `WalletOverride` for `wallet`, created if absent.

instructions.name: settle
docs: PROGRAM §4.5 `settle(quarter)`: compute the quarter's winning box from the pool's axes
and the game's cumulative score (§6.3), verify the passed winner is that box's owner,
fix the prizes on the first call (§5.2), pay the quarter's prize, and with the first
non-zero prize pay the three fees (§5.1). Signer: the keeper. Emits `QuarterSettled`.

accounts.name: score_authority
docs: The keeper, `config.score_authority`; pays the rent of any associated token account this
call creates (PROGRAM §4.5 "The keeper is the payer for any ATA creation").

accounts.name: config
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`; `has_one = score_authority`, read for `fee_wallet`. The
fee amounts moved are the pool's stored ones, never the config's bps.

accounts.name: game
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord`, the pool's game (`has_one`); read for `quarters_posted` and
the cumulative scores.

accounts.name: pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`, re-derived from its own fields.

accounts.name: vault
docs: PROGRAM §3.4 vault at `["vault", pool]`; SOL: system-owned, pays by `transfer` signed
with the vault seeds; SPL: the pool's token account, pays by `transfer_checked` with the
pool PDA as authority.

accounts.name: winner
docs: The winning box's owner: a payout destination, never typed `SystemAccount` (PROGRAM §10
Account types). Computed in the program; this account is only verified against it.

accounts.name: fee_wallet
docs: The platform's fee destination (PROGRAM §3.1); SOL directly, SPL to its ATA.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The creator, paid `creator_fee` with the first prize (PROGRAM §5.1).

accounts.name: integrator
docs: The integrator wallet; required and verified when `pool.integrator != default`, never
read otherwise.

accounts.name: mint

accounts.name: winner_token_account
docs: The winner's associated token account; SPL pools only; created idempotently when the
prize is non-zero.

accounts.name: fee_token_account
docs: `fee_wallet`'s associated token account; SPL pools only; created on the fee-paying call.

accounts.name: creator_token_account
docs: The creator's associated token account; SPL pools only; created on the fee-paying call.

accounts.name: integrator_token_account
docs: The integrator's associated token account; SPL pools with an integrator only.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The pool's token program (checked against `pool.token_program`); SPL pools only.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: The associated-token program, a fixed address; SPL pools only.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: For the SOL transfers out of the vault and any ATA rent.

instructions.name: split
docs: PROGRAM §4.6 `split`: on a suspended game after a prize was paid, fix
`split_amount = unpaid_prize_pool / 25`, move the pool to `Split` and pay the owners in
the remaining accounts that share per unreturned box.
`arbitrary_cpi_call` is allowed here for the same reason as on the handler (see
`instructions/split.rs`): the lint attaches its report to the function it started from,
and this entry point reaches the vault's outbound CPIs through the handler.

this call creates.

accounts.name: pool

prize pool of an `Open`, `Locked` or `Drawn` pool before kickoff. Signer and payer: the
sponsor. Emits `Sponsored`.

accounts.name: sponsor_token_account

future and within 72 hours of the scheduled kickoff. Signer: the keeper. Emits
`KickoffUpdated`.

errors.name: GameAlreadyMarked

errors.name: KickoffInPast
errors.msg: Kickoff must be later than the current time

errors.name: KickoffUpdateTooLate
errors.msg: Kickoff can no longer be updated: the recorded kickoff has passed

errors.name: QuarterOutOfOrder
errors.msg: Quarter must be the next unposted one (1 to 4, in order)

errors.name: QuarterTooSoon
errors.msg: Quarter posted sooner than 15 minutes after kickoff or the previous post

errors.name: ScoreDecreased
errors.msg: A cumulative score is lower than the previous post

errors.name: FinalFlagMismatch
errors.msg: is_final must be set on the fourth post only; had_overtime needs is_final

errors.name: GateKeyNotSigner
errors.msg: Gate key is not a signer

errors.name: IntegratorMismatch
errors.msg: Integrator and integrator fee do not match

errors.name: SponsorshipTooSmall
errors.msg: Sponsorship is below one box price

errors.name: VarAlreadySet
errors.msg: Var is already set on this pool

errors.name: VarNotSet
errors.msg: No Var is set on this pool

errors.name: VarMismatch
errors.msg: Var does not match the one recorded on the pool

errors.name: VarNotEntropy
errors.msg: Account is not an Entropy Var

errors.name: VarProviderMismatch
errors.msg: Var provider does not match the configured provider

errors.name: VarNotFresh
errors.msg: Var is not fresh: it must be committed, unsampled, unrevealed, single-sample, manual, and end in the future

errors.name: VarNotRevealed
errors.msg: Var is not revealed, or its value does not recompute

errors.name: VarNotSampledHere
errors.msg: Var was not sampled through this program, or no longer carries the verified hash

errors.name: SampleWindowMissed
errors.msg: Sample window missed: SlotHashes does not confirm the Var's hash for end_at

errors.name: VarFallbackHash
errors.msg: Var carries the keccak(end_at) fallback hash

errors.name: TooManyVarReplacements
errors.msg: Var has already been replaced twice

errors.name: InvalidGameKey

errors.name: VarAlreadySampled
errors.msg: Var already has a sample recorded

errors.name: VarCommitMismatch
errors.msg: Var seed does not hash to the commit recorded on the pool

docs: PROGRAM §3.5 `CreatorCounter`. 74 bytes = 8 + 66.
Seeds `["counter", creator, game_record]`. Created by `create_pool` when absent (the creator
pays rent) and incremented there; decremented whenever one of the creator's pools on that
game leaves `Open`; closed by `close_counter` at zero, rent to `fee_wallet`.
Layout: discriminator 0 (8); `creator` 8 (32); `game` 40 (32); `open_count` 72; `bump` 73.

types.name: GameRecord
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord`. 153 bytes = 8 + 145.
Seeds `["game", season u16 LE, week u8, home u8, away u8, scheduled_kickoff i64 LE]`, the
six `gameRecordSeeds` in `@mybarpool/shared` produces, in that order.
Layout: discriminator 0 (8); `key` 8 (5: `season` 8, `week` 10, `home` 11, `away` 12);
`scheduled_kickoff` 13; `recorded_kickoff` 21; `status` 29; `quarters_posted` 30;
`home_score` 31 (4 × u16); `away_score` 39 (4 × u16); `posted_at` 47 (4 × i64);
`final_had_overtime` 79; `marked_at` 80; `bump` 88; `reserved` 89 (64).

fields.name: key
docs: PROGRAM §2 game key; part of the seeds.

fields.name: scheduled_kickoff
docs: Seed value; never changes. The 72-hour update bound and the 30-day reclaim clock are
measured from this, never from `recorded_kickoff` (ARCHITECTURE › Trust model).

fields.name: recorded_kickoff
docs: Starts equal to `scheduled_kickoff`; moved by `update_kickoff`. Sales close at this time.

fields.name: status
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameStatus`, one byte on-chain.

fields.name: quarters_posted
docs: 0–4: how many `post_scores` have landed.

fields.name: home_score
docs: Cumulative home score at the end of Q1..Q3 and final (ARCHITECTURE › Payouts).

fields.name: away_score
docs: Same for away.

fields.name: posted_at
docs: Unix time each post landed; 0 until it does.

fields.name: final_had_overtime
docs: Informational, set on the final post.

fields.name: marked_at
docs: Unix time `mark_game` ran; 0 if never.

docs: PDA bump.

types.name: PlatformConfig
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`: the account the rest of the program reads. 698 bytes.
Layout (offsets from the start of the account data): discriminator 0 (8); `admin` 8;
`score_authority` 40; `entropy_provider` 72; `fee_wallet` 104; `platform_bps` 136;
`creator_bps` 138; `addon_budget_bps` 140; `default_preset` 142; `max_open_pools` 143;
`max_own_boxes` 144; `preseason_enabled` 145; `paused` 146; `tokens` 147 (three
`TokenRule` of 98 bytes at 147, 245, 343); `bump` 441; `reserved` 442 (256).

fields.name: admin
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: the Squads vault on mainnet. May not be the default pubkey.

fields.name: score_authority
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: the keeper's KMS key.

docs: PROGRAM §3.1: the Entropy provider whose commits `set_var` accepts.

fields.name: fee_wallet
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: platform fee destination (SOL directly; SPL to its ATA).

fields.name: platform_bps

fields.name: creator_bps

docs: PROGRAM §3.1: creator's boxes in own pool; 1–MAX_OWN_BOXES_ABSOLUTE; initial 5.

fields.name: paused

fields.name: tokens

types.name: Pool
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `Pool`. 1,442 bytes = 8 + 1,434.
Seeds `["pool", game_record, creator, nonce u64 LE]`; `nonce` is chosen by the client so one
creator can have several pools on one game.
Layout (offsets from the start of the account data): `game` 8; `creator` 40; `nonce` 72;
`token` 80; `mint` 81; `token_program` 113; `vault` 145; `price` 177; `preset` 185;
`access_type` 186; `gate_key` 187; `allowlist_root` 219; `creator_addon_bps` 251;
`integrator` 253; `integrator_bps` 285; `platform_fee` 287; `creator_fee` 295;
`integrator_fee` 303; `status` 311; `sold` 312; `owners` 313 (25 × 32); `creator_boxes` 1113;
`sponsored_total` 1114; `sponsor_count` 1122; `sponsorships_open` 1124; `var` 1126;
`var_end_at` 1158; `sampled_slot` 1166; `sampled_hash` 1174; `var_replacements` 1206;
`drawn` 1207; `home_axis` 1208; `away_axis` 1218; `prize_pool` 1228; `quarter_prize` 1236
(4 × 8); `quarters_settled` 1268; `winning_box` 1269; `fees_paid` 1273;
`unpaid_prize_pool` 1274; `returned` 1282; `split_amount` 1286; `cancelled_by_admin` 1294;
`abandoned` 1295; `created_at` 1296; `locked_at` 1304; `bump` 1312; `vault_bump` 1313;
`var_commit` 1314; `reserved` 1346 (96).

fields.name: game
docs: The `GameRecord` (PROGRAM §3.2); part of the seeds.

fields.name: creator
docs: The creator; part of the seeds; receives `creator_fee` at the first settlement.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Client-chosen; part of the seeds.

fields.name: token
docs: PROGRAM §2 token index: 0 SOL, 1 SKR, 2 ORE.

fields.name: mint
docs: Copied from `config.tokens[token]` at creation; `Pubkey::default()` for SOL.

fields.name: token_program
docs: Copied from `config.tokens[token]` at creation; `Pubkey::default()` for SOL.

fields.name: vault
docs: The vault (PROGRAM §3.4) at `["vault", pool]`.

fields.name: price
docs: Per box, base units; on the token's ladder at creation.

fields.name: preset
docs: PROGRAM §1 payout preset.

fields.name: access_type
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 access type.

fields.name: gate_key
docs: Co-signer for `Link` pools; default otherwise.

fields.name: allowlist_root
docs: Merkle root for `Allowlist` pools; zero otherwise.

fields.name: creator_addon_bps
docs: 0–500: extra fee to the creator on top of the base share.

fields.name: integrator
docs: The client that created the pool, when it takes a fee; default when unset.

fields.name: integrator_bps
docs: 0–500; 0 when `integrator` is unset.

fields.name: platform_fee
docs: PROGRAM §5.1, fixed at creation.

fields.name: creator_fee
docs: PROGRAM §5.1, fixed at creation: base and add-on in one amount.

fields.name: integrator_fee
docs: PROGRAM §5.1, fixed at creation; 0 when unset.

fields.name: status
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 / §9 status.

fields.name: sold
docs: Boxes sold, 0–25.

fields.name: owners
docs: Box owners by 0-based index; `Pubkey::default()` is unsold.

fields.name: creator_boxes
docs: Boxes the creator holds in this pool, against the creator cap.

fields.name: sponsored_total
docs: Sum of all sponsorships (PROGRAM §3.7); never part of the fee base.

fields.name: sponsor_count
docs: Distinct sponsor wallets ever.

fields.name: sponsorships_open
docs: `Sponsorship` accounts not yet closed.

fields.name: var
docs: Entropy `Var` recorded at lock (Step 5); default until then.

fields.name: var_end_at
docs: The `Var`'s `end_at` (Step 5); 0 until then.

fields.name: sampled_slot
docs: Slot at which `sample_var` ran (Step 5); 0 until then.

fields.name: sampled_hash
docs: The slot hash `sample_var` verified against (Step 5); zero until then.

fields.name: var_replacements
docs: Admin `replace_var` calls so far (Step 5); max 2.

fields.name: drawn
docs: Axes drawn (Step 5).

fields.name: home_axis
docs: Home (column) digits after the draw; lane `l` = positions `l`, `l + 5`.

fields.name: away_axis
docs: Away (row) digits after the draw.

fields.name: prize_pool
docs: Fixed at the first settlement (Step 6); 0 before.

fields.name: quarter_prize
docs: Fixed at the first settlement (Step 6).

fields.name: winning_box
docs: Winning box per quarter; `NO_WINNING_BOX` (255) until settled.

fields.name: fees_paid
docs: True once the first non-zero prize has been paid (Step 6).

fields.name: unpaid_prize_pool
docs: `prize_pool` minus prizes paid so far (Step 6).

fields.name: returned
docs: Bitmap over boxes: returned, split or reclaimed (Step 7).

fields.name: split_amount
docs: Per-box amount fixed when the pool enters `Split` or is first reclaimed after a payout (Step 7).

fields.name: cancelled_by_admin
docs: Set by `cancel_pool` (Step 7).

fields.name: abandoned
docs: Set by the first `reclaim` or `reclaim_sponsorship` (Step 7).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix time of `create_pool`.

fields.name: locked_at
docs: Unix time the 25th box sold; 0 until locked.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump of the pool.

fields.name: vault_bump
docs: PDA bump of the vault.

fields.name: var_commit
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 (Step 5b): the `Var`'s `commit` as recorded by `set_var` / `replace_var`;
`draw` requires `keccak(var.seed)` to equal it. Taken out of `reserved` so no earlier
offset moves. Zero on an unbound pool.

fields.name: reserved
docs: PROGRAM §3 preamble: padding so fields can be appended without a migration (128
through Step 5).

fields.name: price

fields.name: access_type
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 access type.

fields.name: platform_fee
docs: PROGRAM §5.1.

docs: PROGRAM §5.1.

types.name: PoolStatus
docs: PROGRAM §3.3 `PoolStatus`; the discriminant is the on-chain byte. PROGRAM §9: `Settled`,
`Returned` and `Split` are terminal. "Live" is not a state: clients derive it as `Drawn`
with `now ≥ game.recorded_kickoff`.

types.name: QuarterSettled
docs: PROGRAM §7 `QuarterSettled`: one quarter paid (or recorded, on a zero share). The three fee
fields are the amounts moved in **this** call — the pool's stored fees when `fees_paid_now`,
zero otherwise (the stored amounts are in `PoolCreated`). Clients show a box as won only on
this event.

fields.name: time
docs: Unix time of the write.

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool's address.

fields.name: home
docs: Cumulative home score at the end of the quarter (PROGRAM §3.2).

fields.name: away
docs: Cumulative away score.

fields.name: box_index
docs: The winning box, 0-based (PROGRAM §6.3). Named `box_index` here because `box` is a Rust
keyword and Anchor would carry the raw identifier `r#box` into the IDL; §7's `box`.

fields.name: winner
docs: The box's owner at settlement, who was paid `amount`.

fields.name: amount
docs: `quarter_prize[quarter − 1]`; 0 on a zero-share quarter.

fields.name: fees_paid_now
docs: True on the call that moved the fees (the first non-zero prize).

fields.name: platform_fee

types.name: Sponsorship
docs: PROGRAM §3.7 `Sponsorship`. 81 bytes = 8 + 73.
Seeds `["sponsorship", pool, wallet]`. Created by the first `sponsor` from that wallet (the
sponsor pays rent), topped up by later ones; closed in Step 7 with rent to `wallet`.
Layout: discriminator 0 (8); `pool` 8 (32); `wallet` 40 (32); `amount` 72 (8); `bump` 80.

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool; part of the seeds.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The sponsor; part of the seeds; the only possible return destination.

fields.name: amount
docs: Cumulative amount in the pool's token, base units.

fields.name: bump

(`close_sponsorship`, §4.6); the amount stays in the pool.

Layout: discriminator 0 (8); `wallet` 8 (32); `max_open_pools` 40; `max_own_boxes` 41;
`bump` 42. No `reserved` field (ARCHITECTURE › Open source names the pool and config
accounts as the padded ones).

constants.name: ADDON_BUDGET_BPS_MAX
docs: PROGRAM §1 `ADDON_BUDGET_BPS_MAX`: ceiling on `creator_addon_bps + integrator_bps`.

constants.name: AXIS_LABEL_AWAY
docs: PROGRAM §6.2: the away (row) axis label.

constants.name: AXIS_LABEL_HOME
docs: PROGRAM §6.2: the home (column) axis label.

constants.name: BOXES
docs: PROGRAM §1 `BOXES`: boxes per pool.

constants.name: BPS_DENOMINATOR
docs: PROGRAM §5.1: basis points are out of 10 000.

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig` seed.

constants.name: COUNTER_SEED
docs: PROGRAM §3.5 `CreatorCounter` seed prefix; creator and game record follow.

constants.name: CREATOR_BPS_MAX
docs: PROGRAM §1 `CREATOR_BPS_MAX`: ceiling on the creator base share.

constants.name: ENTROPY_PROGRAM
docs: PROGRAM §1 `ENTROPY_PROGRAM`: the platform's own deployment of Entropy — the fork
`war2wigz/entropy` at `ENTROPY_FORK_COMMIT` (see `tests/helpers/entropy.ts` and `ci.yml`) of
`regolith-labs/entropy` `f26ae03`, with the program id changed, `Open` re-enabled and the
`security.txt` contact changed, nothing else (ARCHITECTURE › Randomness). Through Step 5 the
constant was Regolith's `3jSkUuYBoJzQPMEzTvkDFXCZUBksPamrVhrnHR9igu2X`.

docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord` seed prefix; season, week, home, away and scheduled kickoff follow.

constants.name: KICKOFF_UPDATE_BOUND
docs: PROGRAM §1 `KICKOFF_UPDATE_BOUND`: 72 hours; how far a recorded kickoff may move from the scheduled one.

constants.name: LANES
docs: PROGRAM §1 `LANES`: positions per axis; lane `l` holds digits at positions `l` and `l + 5`.

constants.name: MAX_OWN_BOXES_ABSOLUTE
docs: PROGRAM §1 `MAX_OWN_BOXES_ABSOLUTE`: upper bound on any configured creator box cap.

constants.name: MIN_QUARTER_SECONDS
docs: PROGRAM §1 `MIN_QUARTER_SECONDS`: a quarter's worth of football takes at least this long in real time.

constants.name: NO_WINNING_BOX

constants.name: OVERRIDE_SEED

constants.name: PLATFORM_BPS_MAX

constants.name: POOL_SEED

constants.name: QUARTERS
docs: PROGRAM §1 `QUARTERS`: settlement periods; the fourth is the final score.

constants.name: RECLAIM_DELAY
docs: PROGRAM §1 `RECLAIM_DELAY`: 30 days; abandoned-pool reclaim opens this long after the scheduled kickoff.

constants.name: SPONSORSHIP_SEED
docs: PROGRAM §3.7 `Sponsorship` seed prefix; pool and wallet follow.
